purpose: The `sldb stores semantic-map` command: Map equivalent semantic concepts.
how_it_works: Implemented under src/sldb/cli/parsers/ as the argparse subcommand 'semantic-map'. It parses the listed arguments and dispatches to its handler in the sldb CLI runtime over the .sldb store.
